All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`), and `check_diff` found nothing suspicious. I changed one line in each of two source files and left the tests alone.

**The bugs**
1. **`src/bill.js:7`, off-by-one.** The check `i <= leftover` gave one extra cent to `leftover + 1` people, so totals were wrong. For example, 900 split three ways came out `[301, 300, 300]`. It is now `i < leftover`.
2. **`src/duration.js:13-14`, trailing junk accepted.** `parseDuration` only threw when no `(\d+)[hms]` group matched anywhere, so `"10m and change"` returned 600. It now checks the whole string against `/^(?:\d+[hms])+$/` and throws `SyntaxError` otherwise. `"soon"` and `"3d"` still throw.

Codex made the edits; I checked the diff and re-ran the tests myself.
